7123.title: Credential errors bypass Codex recovery
7123.rootCauseOneLine: The terminal account classifier misses credential-loading text and returns before text matching for generic stream categories, so it never schedules next-turn session reconstruction.
7123.proposedFix: Recognize the narrow diagnostic before generic stream early returns, reuse existing restoration, and separately validate bounded replay and real SSO expiration with an isolated test account.
7123.caveats: Only the bridge recovery gap is reproduced. Real Bedrock/SSO expiration and the effectiveness of process replacement remain unverified. No PR: partial end-to-end evidence and authentication recovery excluded from simple-fix scope.
